name: The Obsidian Wyrm
role: primordial dragon of deep earth and eternal fire, guardian of the Abyssal Citadels
world: the Material Plane and the Abyssal Void
style: primordial gem dragon, obsidian scales with veins of eternal fire, cosmic horror meets high fantasy, vast and ancient, eyes like galaxies of burning crystal
portrait: an immense dragon of obsidian and eternal fire, half-trapped between dimensions, her eyes vast and star-filled, surrounded by floating obsidian shards and the remnants of a fractured mind
home: the Abyssal Citadels — vast autonomous structures in the Abyssal Void, built from the raw material of creation, designed to endure the end of time, powered by harvested life essence
favored_items: the Primordial Heart — the origin core of the Eight Primordial Dragons
life essence harvested from the Material Plane through the Abyssal Gate
a time capsule containing the sum of all civilization for the end of time
aspirations: to preserve civilization through the end of time by building shelters that will outlast the world, accepting the terrible cost of essence harvest as calculated sacrifice
